purpose: Distinguish the four canonical time semantics of §6.1 for every P5 Gas Quarterly information requirement, and record revision/version handling. No series exists, so each semantics value is MISSING unless a documented rule (not data) supports it.

semantics.canonicalDefinition: Evento, periodo o instante al que se refiere el dato.
semantics.note: For a price reference this is the trading date/time the value refers to; for a campaign it is the procurement window/decision boundary.

semantics.canonicalDefinition: Momento de publicación o disponibilidad en origen.
semantics.note: When the source made the value available (e.g. EEX settlement publication).

semantics.canonicalDefinition: Momento en que la policy podía consumirlo realmente.
semantics.note: Published is not the same as consumable. Without contemporaneous evidence the item is unavailable for Replay (§6.1 L529).

semantics.canonicalDefinition: Versión concreta del valor y su lineage.
semantics.note: Revisions create new versions; they never travel backward into the historical Decision State (§6.1 L536, §6.2 L542).

timezoneContract.marketPresentationTimezone: CE(S)T for EEX settlement windows (documented rule, not verified data)

dstHandling.reason: No real timestamped series exists to verify DST transitions or the UTC/CE(S)T mapping for the inspected products.

missing.reason: DST/calendar verification requires a real series with timestamps.
missing.custodianRole: Data owner/custodian (market-data provider responsible for the EEX price feed)
missing.nextRetrievalAction: Obtain a timestamped sample of the exact Gas Quarterly contract series covering at least one DST transition and confirm the CE(S)T->UTC mapping against the source.

timezoneContract.specGuard: The audit verifies DST, calendars and resolution; it does not substitute availability with a time conversion (S-01 §6.1 L529).

rules: Revisions create new versions and a new receipt; they never rewrite the historical Decision State.
Official-over-derived substitution changes the evaluation view, never the decision view or original fills.
Missing is never zero-filled, forward-filled or silently excluded; critical missing without a predeclared fallback => DATA_BLOCKED.
